name: Gyulakeszi (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gyulakeszi (a white and green shield with a castle, a bunch of grapes and a vine leaf) above the name GYULAKESZI in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
